他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “正好，他找到了别的花” / Formula: Use a time/sequence connector when an event happens later: 后来/最后/终于 + subject + verb / Correct: “后来，他找到了另一种花。” “正好” means “just at the right moment” or “exactly,” so it is less suitable here.

items.reason: “别的花” should be “另外一种花” here; “正好” is also acceptable, but the proposed corrected sentence is grammatical and correct.
